title: Normalized acyclicity fills compatible simplicial abelian boundaries
statement: Let $G:\Delta^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Ab}$ be a simplicial abelian group with face maps $d_i$ [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object]. Define $N(G)_0=G_0$ and $N(G)_m=\bigcap_{i=1}^m\ker(d_i:G_m\to G_{m-1})$ for $m>0$, with differential $\partial_m=d_0$ for $m>0$ and $\partial_0:G_0\to0$. Assume $\ker\partial_m=\operatorname{im}\partial_{m+1}$ for every $m\geq0$. For every $n\geq1$ and every family $a_0,\ldots,a_n\in G_{n-1}$ satisfying $d_i a_j=d_{j-1}a_i$ for $0\leq i<j\leq n$ when $n\geq2$ (no compatibility equations when $n=1$), there exists $v\in G_n$ with $d_i v=a_i$ for every $0\leq i\leq n$.

source.place: Tag 08P1 (lemma-qis-simplicial-abelian-groups), third proof paragraph: horn filler and residual normalized cycle, using Tag 08NZ (lemma-simplicial-group-kan). Omit face 0 for the positive-face/d_0 normalization. Returned proof Steps 5-6.

proof.text: Fix $n\geq1$ and the given compatible boundary. Discard $a_0$ and apply [lem-trf-simplicial-abelian-horn-filling] with missing index $k=0$. Its compatibility hypotheses are the given equations restricted to $1\leq i<j\leq n$; for $n=1$ both sets of equations are empty. Obtain $u\in G_n$ with $d_i u=a_i$ for $1\leq i\leq n$. Set $r=a_0-d_0u\in G_{n-1}$.

source.place: Tag 08NZ (lemma-simplicial-group-kan), compatible-face horn-filling statement, used with missing face 0; Tag 08P1 third proof paragraph.

proof.text: For $n\geq2$, contravariant functoriality of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] applied to [lem-weil-pbc-simplex-face-face-identity] gives $d_jd_0=d_0d_{j+1}$ for $0\leq j\leq n-1$. The boundary equation for the pair $(0,j+1)$ is $d_j a_0=d_0a_{j+1}$. Since the face maps are homomorphisms, for every such $j$ we get $$d_j r=d_j a_0-d_jd_0u=d_0a_{j+1}-d_0d_{j+1}u=0.$$ Thus the positive faces $d_1r,\ldots,d_{n-1}r$ vanish, so $r\in N(G)_{n-1}$, and $\partial_{n-1}r=d_0r=0$.

source.place: Tag 08P1 (lemma-qis-simplicial-abelian-groups), third proof paragraph, with face 0 omitted to match the positive-face/d_0 normalization; Tag 08NZ (lemma-simplicial-group-kan) supplies the horn filler.

proof.text: For $n=1$, $r\in G_0=N(G)_0$ and $\partial_0r=0$, since $\partial_0$ has target zero. This uses no face map out of $G_0$ and no boundary compatibility equation. Hence in every degree under consideration, $r\in\ker\partial_{n-1}$.

source.place: Tag 08P1 (lemma-qis-simplicial-abelian-groups), third proof paragraph, with face 0 omitted to match the positive-face/d_0 normalization; Tag 08NZ (lemma-simplicial-group-kan) supplies the horn filler.

proof.text: Apply the assumed equality $\ker\partial_{n-1}=\operatorname{im}\partial_n$ to $r$. By the definition of image there is $w\in N(G)_n$ with $\partial_n w=d_0w=r$. By the stated definition of $N(G)_n$, $d_iw=0$ for $1\leq i\leq n$. Set $v=u+w\in G_n$. Additivity of the face homomorphisms [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] gives $d_0v=d_0u+r=a_0$ and $d_iv=a_i+0=a_i$ for $1\leq i\leq n$. These are all the required faces.
